# Packages
library(DESeq2)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)

# inputs you have:
# counts: genes x samples raw counts (matrix or data.frame)
# meta:   data.frame with one row per sample and columns like leachate, stage, etc.
# Ensure column order matches: colnames(counts) == rownames(meta)

## 1) transform counts (variance-stabilizing; keeps nonnegative scale roughly)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(as.matrix(counts)),
                              colData   = meta,
                              design    = ~ 1)
vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE))           # genes x samples (real-valued)

## 2) (optional) rescale to nonnegative for Bray–Curtis
# Bray–Curtis expects nonnegative. If vst yields negatives, shift up:
shift <- -min(vst_mat)
if (shift > 0) vst_mat <- vst_mat + shift

## 3) compute distance between samples (rows = samples)
bc <- vegdist(t(vst_mat), method = "bray")

## 4) PERMANOVA
set.seed(1)
adonis2(bc ~ leachate * stage, data = meta, permutations = 999, by = "terms")
